stem: A client who feels strong unconscious resentment toward a relative behaves with exaggerated affection and praise toward that person. Which defense mechanism does this behavior illustrate?
rationale: Reaction formation occurs when an unacceptable or threatening impulse is denied and replaced with an opposite, acceptable impulse or behavior. Exaggerated affection that masks underlying resentment is consistent with this mechanism.
educational_objective: Recognize reaction formation as expression of the opposite of an unacceptable underlying impulse.
source_document_title: Nursing: Mental Health and Community Concepts, 2nd ed.—Table 3.4 Common Defense Mechanisms
source_claim_supported: Reaction formation replaces an unacceptable impulse with an opposite, acceptable impulse.
correction_summary: Condensed the vignette and aligned terminology exactly with the current Open RN defense-mechanism table.
audit_findings: Behavior maps directly to reaction formation.
